{{Quote|ZIRO'S PALACE|The Palace's Marquee|<ref name="TCWfilm">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]]</ref>}}
'''Ziro's Palace''' was the personal residence and lair of [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro Desilijic Tiure]]. Located on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], Ziro operated a [[Cantina/Legends|nightclub]] within the palace, after moving from [[Sleheyron/Legends|Sleheyron]]. This would serve as the headquarters of Ziro's criminal enterprise in the time leading up the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. After Ziro's role in the kidnapping of his nephew [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt's]] son [[Rotta/Legends|Rotta]] was exposed, the Palace most likely became abandoned after Ziro was taken into Republic custody.

==History==
After moving to Coruscant from the world of [[Sleheyron/Legends|Sleheyron]] where he worked for some time as a [[Desilijic/Legends|Desilijic]] loan shark to purse larger fortunes, Ziro setup new headquarters in a seedier neighborhood of the capital. He purchased a rundown tower that once belonged to the [[Lantillian Spacers' Brotherhood/Legends|Lantillian Spacers' Brotherhood]] and remade it as a gaudy pleasure palace.<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars: The Visual Guide">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: The Visual Guide]]''</ref>

Over the years, Ziro's Palace became a popular gathering place for dregs of the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant underworld]]. If a galactic lowlife with either a fearsome reputation or a lot of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|Credits]] made their way to the [[Coruscant/Legends|Galactic Capital]], they eventually found their way into Ziro's court. Among those likely to be found where [[Slavery/Legends|Trandoshan slavers]], [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] thugs, sleazy humans, even renegade droids.<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars: The Visual Guide" />

In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] traveled to the palace when she was attempting to forge an agreement between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Desilijic/Legends|Hutt clan]]. When she was captured by Ziro, who was in league with [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], she was [[Raid on Ziro the Hutt's Coruscant club|rescued]] by [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Fox/Legends|Fox]] and the [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guard]]. Ziro was captured, arrested and sent to the [[Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center/Legends|Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center]].
